sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art for a 2D medieval fantasy mobile game. Input image 1 is STYLE ONLY: use the same clean comic fantasy style as the approved shop icons, crisp dark espresso outlines, deliberate chunky shapes, restrained two or three hard-edged cel-shaded values, large readable color planes, limited broad upper-left highlights. Hand-drawn game illustration, coherent line weight. Avoid soft airbrush gradients, photorealism, glossy plastic, metallic over-rendering, microtextures, random filigree, sparkle clouds, excessive glow, text, lettering, logo, watermark, UI frames. Asset type: portrait background illustration for a hero equipment screen, 2:3 composition. A quiet, sunlit royal guild armory inside a pale sandstone castle: one broad rounded window toward the upper right showing a little blue sky, a simple indigo banner, two racks with a few recognizable wooden shields and simple medieval equipment along the distant walls. Big plain pale warm gray stone wall areas and a clean flat stone floor. The central and left-middle 60% are uncluttered open staging space for separately rendered characters and gear UI. Gentle warm ivory and muted slate-blue environment, restrained green accents. Clearly designed perspective, two or three simple architectural layers. No characters, no pedestals, no inset panels, no magical glyphs, no dark cave, no decorative borders. Relatively low contrast so crisp character sprites and UI remain the focal point; broad illustrated forms, no artificial depth-of-field.
